queries.result: The first-party search did not identify a separate French-language Victoria parcel custodian. The official English provincial mapping resources and CRD service remained the relevant first-party sources; no inference of absence was made.

researchNote: A local CRD parcel/lot-boundary service and provincial ParcelMap BC service are evidenced.
